versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Anthropic brand-guidelines skill.
- Applies official brand colors and typography to artifacts for consistent Anthropic styling.
- Supports Poppins for headings and Lora for body text, with automatic fallback to common system fonts.
- Uses specified main and accent colors (dark, light, gray, orange, blue, green) for visual formatting.
- Ensures smart color and font application for headings, body text, and shapes.
- No font installation required; works with system fonts for broad compatibility.
